# IndexProjectGraph

## Rules

- `IndexProjectGraph.execute(input)` builds `IndexOptions` from `projectRoot`, `workspaces`, `graphConfig`, `codeGraphVersion`, `vcsRoot`, optional `vcsRef`, `onProgress`, and `force`; calls `provider.index()`; returns `IndexResult` unchanged.
- `force` requests complete logical reindex: provider clears reusable indexed contents and bypasses incremental reuse so every selected input is reconsidered.
- Input contains already-open `provider` and prepared project values. Forward `vcsRoot` unchanged.
- MUST NOT resolve workspaces, lock, spawn, open, close, directly clear, recreate, or own storage recovery/lifecycle. SDK lifecycle owner handles recoverable open failures.
- `createIndexProjectGraph()` returns stateless `IndexProjectGraph`.

## Constraints

- No provider open/close or index-lock acquisition/release.
- Per-file parse failures remain `IndexResult.errors`; use case does not throw them.
